The `enums.viewMode.` prefix is a codegen/serialization artifact leaking into a user-facing API response — the same class of issue as a raw internal field name. A consumer reading this field gets an internal type path rather than a usable mode value.

FAILED: `chat-settings` returns `viewMode` as a raw internal enum identifier (`"enums.viewMode.linear"`) instead of a clean value (`"linear"`) — an internal serialization artifact leaking into a user-facing field.
